actual_compute_cost.cost_scope: Only newly executed round 4 work; reused parent models and predictions are provenance references and add zero new fitting cost.
actual_compute_cost.engine_execution_attempt_scope: Measured execution_state.json attempts, including the separately executed pilot and failed attempts; excludes unmeasured interrupted attempts.
actual_compute_cost.supervisor_scope: RUSAGE_CHILDREN for completed phases across unique supervisor sessions; excludes the pilot executed before supervision. Final Git publication overhead is recorded subsequently in runtime state.
actual_compute_cost.accounting_rule: OVERLAPPING_VIEWS_DO_NOT_ADD: engine job CPU is contained in execution-attempt CPU; supervised execution-attempt CPU is contained in supervisor child-phase CPU. The separately run pilot is absent from supervisor measurements but present in the engine ledger. These views must never be summed as independent costs.
actual_compute_cost.unknown_cpu_policy: CPU of interrupted attempts without a persisted measurement remains unknown; reported measured totals are lower bounds when such attempts exist.

publication: The receipt and listed artifacts are committed together, then pushed without force.
